_comment: Example icon manifest for gen_icons_cf.py. KEEP EVERY PROMPT SHORT: CLIP-style models take 77 tokens and truncate the rest SILENTLY. The style field is pasted onto every prompt verbatim: change it for the whole set or not at all. A GREY subject on a grey backdrop cannot be separated from its own drop shadow, so give grey items a colour. SYMBOLIC icons (close, tick, heart, star, lock, plus, minus, arrow) do NOT belong here: scripts/glyphs.py draws them, because generators return scribbles for geometry. A hosted API can refuse an innocent prompt (a safety-filter false positive): reword it, do not retry it. Fields: name (file name), group (optional tag for keeping a family consistent), prompt (the subject only).

assets.name: coin
assets.prompt: a gold coin with a star embossed on it

assets.name: gem
assets.prompt: a cut blue gemstone, faceted, cyan highlights

assets.name: potion
assets.prompt: a round red potion bottle with a cork

assets.name: chest
assets.prompt: a closed wooden treasure chest with gold trim
